tool.name: OpenReadout metadata
tool.description: of raw instrument files (CZI, ND2, LIF, FCS, Thermo RAW, mzML, ...) as JSON
tool.command: @LINK_INPUT@ openreadout #if $detail.mode == 'full' info '$input_name' --view full #if not $detail.vendor --no-vendor #end if #if $detail.all_frames --all-frames #end if #elif $detail.mode == 'check' check '$input_name' #else info '$input_name' #end if --json > '$output' #if $detail.mode == 'check' ## `check` exits 4 when it finds problems: keep the report, fail only on other errors || [ \$? -eq 4 ] #end if

param.name: input
param.label: Instrument file
param.help: Detected from its content: CZI, ND2, LIF, OIR, VSI, whole-slide and OME-TIFF, FCS, Thermo RAW, mzML/mzXML, ChemStation, ANDI, ABF, JCAMP-DX, plate-reader exports, qPCR (RDML, EDS), ...

param.name: mode
param.label: What to report
param.option: Summary with per-plane records, vendor metadata and provenance (openreadout info --view full)

tool.help:
**What it does**
Reads a raw laboratory instrument file without the vendor's software and reports what is in it as JSON:
- **Metadata** (``openreadout info``): the format, and depending on the file the images (dimensions, pixel type, physical pixel size, channels with wavelengths, objective, pyramid levels), tables (FCS data sets with their parameters, plate reads), traces (electrophysiology sweeps, chromatograms, NMR FIDs and spectra), mass-spectrometry runs (scan count, MS levels, retention-time range, instrument), and the experiment (sample, method, operator, acquisition time). Reads headers only, so it is fast on multi-gigabyte files. - **Full metadata** (``openreadout info --view full``): the summary plus per-plane acquisition records, the vendor's own metadata tree and the provenance of every normalized field. - **Integrity check** (``openreadout check``): structural validation and data checksums; the report lists every finding.
**Input**
Any supported file; the format is detected from the content. Data sets stored as directories (Bruker ``.d``, Agilent ``.D``, Waters ``.raw``) are not supported in Galaxy.
**Output**
The JSON envelope ``{"ok": true, "schema_version": ..., "data": {...}}``; the schema is ``docs/schema/info.schema.json`` in the OpenReadout repository.
@HELP_FOOTER@
